Additional sector recommendations
• Describe the approach to engaging with stakeholders whose rights to land
and resources are or could be affected by the organization’s activities,
including:
- how the organization seeks to ensure meaningful engagement;
- how the organization supports safe and equitable gender participation.
• Describe the policies, commitments, and plans providing remediation to local
communities or individuals subject to involuntary resettlement, and the
process for establishing compensation for loss of assets, or other assistance
to improve or restore standards of living or livelihoods.
• Describe the procedures in place to monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of
the actions taken to remediate negative impacts from involuntary resettlement
and the corrective actions taken where necessary.17
